turns.question: How many delivery-topic customer service calls were there per 100 shipped orders in September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no calls-per-100-shipped-orders metric, and I may not compute the ratio myself; the closest metrics are Calls labelled (delivery-topic) and Orders (status shipped). For 1-30 September 2026 it gives 1 delivery-topic call labelled (a model-derived label) and 50 shipped orders.
